entries.german:
Rudolf von Rorschach übergibt seinem Bruder Eglolf den vierten Teil des väterlichen Erbes.

In dem namin diz vattirs vnd a) sunis vnd dis heiligin geistis. Suln alle die wissin, die disin brief an sehint, daz her Rv odolf von Ror||schach von sinis vattirs gv ote Egilolue sinin brv odere 1 gap din vierdinteil des gv otis, des er imme zirehte teilin solte. Vnd sint daz div || gv ot, div hic nach gischribin stant, div Egilolue sint wordin zi rehtim teile nach ir beidir frivnde rat vnd ouch nach der livte sage, die || vmb ir beidir teil gisworn hattin. Daz ist der hof zi Tivfinbach 2, livte vnd gv ot mit allime rechte, daz ist vier phunt phenninge von der altun vogitstivre in dem houe zi Rorschahc. Vnd sol man ouch wissin, daz her Rv odolf Egilolue sinem brv odere ouch gab drizic mark vur din vierdinteil sinre burc zi Rorschach, alse si ouch in an kam von sinen bru odiren zi rechtime teile, vnd gab imme o vch zwenzik mark vur eine huobe, die er imme ouch solte han gigebin zi rechtim teile. Da bi sol man ouch wissin, daz der selbe Egilolf sich het vurzigin mv otwillecliche teilis widir sinem brv odir her Ru odoluen an Jacobe hern Rv odoluis amman, an Diethelme von Golda 3, an Cv onrate Liupman, an Rv odolue dime Hamere vnd an den hagistolzen zi Rorschach, mit wibin vnd mit kindin, die hie ginemit sint, also daz her Rv odolf die selbin sol Egilolue widerlegin, als in her Cv onrat von Ramiswac 4 heizit vnd dir Schenke von Landegke 5. Vnd sol man wissin, daz her Rv odolf ist gischeidin uon Egilolue sinem bruodere mit rechteme teile an liuten vnd an gv ote, wan alleine vmbe die edilin livte, die ir vattir warin, vnd umb die manlehin, die man uon ir vattir hatte, vnd ane die hagistolze, die hie niht vzginomin sint. Diz gischach vor dim appite Berhtolde 6 zi geginwirtiv hern Heinrich von Valkinstein 7, hern Rv odolue uon Guttingin 8, hern Heinrich uon Griezinberc 9, hern Arnolde uon Bivrgelon 10, hern Heinriche uon Rauinsburc 11, hern Egilolue von Rosinberc 12 vnd hern Egilolue von Rosinburc 13, hern Cv onrat von Ramiswak 4, hern Heinriche dim Schenkin 5, hern Wilhelme von Steina 14, hern Goeswine von Emiz 15, hern Cv onrat von Griminstein 16, dim marschalke uon Valkinstein 17, hern Bertholde von Annewiler 18, hern Hermanne von Grv oninstein 19, zwein von Edankiswiler 20, hern Egilolue von Palus 21, hern Heinriche von Tunretun 22, hern Huge von Eschinze 23, hern Rv odolue von Rinegke 24, hern Wezzil Snoede 25, hern Hartmanne von Nidirndorf 26. Dise sint des gizivge, daz diz gischach, vnd sahinz vnd hortins. Darzv o ist disiv gischiht bistetet mit appit Bertholdis brieue vnd mit sineme ingisigele.

Siegel: Siegel fehlt.
entries.english: In the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. Let all who see this letter know that Rudolf von Rorschach gave his brother Egilolf one quarter of the property that he was entitled to divide. The holdings assigned to Egilolf by right, following the advice of their relatives and the testimony of those who swore concerning their respective shares, were the estate at Tiefenbach, its people and property with all rights, and four pounds in pennies from the old bailiff’s tax on the estate at Rorschach. Rudolf also gave Egilolf 30 marks for his quarter of the castle at Rorschach, which had come to him by rightful division among their brothers, and 20 marks for a hide that he should likewise have given him as his rightful share. Egilolf voluntarily renounced his share to his brother Rudolf in Jacob, Rudolf’s official; Diethelm von Golda; Konrad Liupman; Rudolf the Hammer; and the hagistolze at Rorschach named here, with their wives and children. Rudolf is to compensate Egilolf for them as Konrad von Ramswag and the Schenk von Landegg direct. Rudolf and Egilolf were duly divided in people and property, except for the noble people who had belonged to their father, the fiefs held from their father, and the hagistolze not excepted here. This was done before Abbot Berchtold, in the presence of Heinrich von Valkinstein; Rudolf von Guttingin; Heinrich von Griezinberc; Arnold von Bivrgelon; Heinrich von Rauinsburc; Egilolf von Rosenberg and Egilolf von Rosinburc; Konrad von Ramiswak; Heinrich der Schenk; Wilhelm von Steina; Goeswin von Emiz; Konrad von Griminstein; the marshal von Valkinstein; Berthold von Annewiler; Hermann von Grvoninstein; two men von Edankiswiler; Egilolf von Palus; Heinrich von Tunretun; Hugo von Eschinze; Rudolf von Rinegke; Wezzil Snoede; Hartmann von Nidirndorf. These witnesses saw and heard it. The abbot confirmed the matter by his letter and seal. The seal is missing.
